name: Jira Cloud
covers: Issues, search, transitions, comments, worklogs, attachments, custom fields, projects, users, boards, sprints
credential: Atlassian account email and API token
credentialNote: Sent as Basic auth with the account's email address, which goes in email

supported.api: REST API 3 and Agile REST API 1.0
supported.note: Jira Cloud is always current. toil calls REST API 3 (/rest/api/3, with the enhanced JQL search at /rest/api/3/search/jql) and the Agile REST API 1.0, with an Atlassian account email and API token sent as Basic auth. Nothing has been run against a live site yet.
